note: A DATA line with no LF is buffered whole (src/smtp/session.rs read_until without take). Also pinned in cargo test: tests/finding_f1_data_line.rs.
timeouts.session cancels an in-flight relay: duplicate on retry, uncommitted delivery, leaked registry entry. Also pinned in cargo test: tests/findings.rs.
simmer_unmatched_sender_total{domain} is client-controlled. Capping it diverges from SPEC.md §9.1 and needs the spec author. Also pinned in cargo test: tests/metrics_endpoint.rs.
Outbound AUTH is always PLAIN (src/downstream/client.rs): a downstream offering only LOGIN answers 535 and Simmer defers 451 on every retry. Observed against postfix-login-only in the T2 matrix.

The outbound EHLO names the downstream's own host (src/downstream/client.rs `ehlo(&ds.host)`), not server.hostname (SPEC §4.1: the EHLO identity). A downstream that rejects clients claiming its own name defers every message 451 (D-023). Observed in every Postfix Received: header in the T2 matrix.
